title: Rhonda R NDE 6343
content: I awoke and felt very dizzy and sick. I moved to lie down upon the couch and go back to sleep. Something kept waking me up; I had the strong feeling to call my sister. I did not want to bother her and I doubted she would be home but I called because I kept having that nagging feeling. My sister was at home and when I related my feeling she told me to come on out to her home. I told her I wasn't sure I could drive, so she and her sons came to get me. I went to her couch and laid down there. I would have died there on her couch but the doorbell rang and a friend of hers, who is a police officer, came in. He was not expected and had not planned to drive the 45 minutes that morning to her home but later said something had just kept telling to go to her home. When he came in and saw me on the couch, he asked what was wrong with me. My sister told him that I wasn't feeling well. He stepped toward the couch to talk to me. By this time, I had already turned blue. The last memory I had was of Steve telling my sister to call an ambulance. He then said, 'we don't have time for an ambulance, do you know any first responders!' The next thing I knew I was in an ambulance an Emergency Medical Technician was sitting beside me. I could read his thoughts. He was thinking how terrible it was that I was dying so young and that there was nothing he could do to help me. I could see my body and see him sitting next to me while I read his thoughts. I had the feeling of someone near me. I thought, 'Am I dying?' A very kind female voice spoke to me saying, 'No. That would never be asked of your parents.' (My family had just lost my 27-year-old brother two years earlier from cancer.) This being, I believe, was an angel. The calm and feeling of pure unconditional love that emanated from her was far past anything possible for human beings. The angel told me not to fear the there was nothing wrong with me. She told me they would run tests on me, a lot of tests, but never fear for they will find nothing. She told me again not to fear there was nothing wrong with me. I felt such a peace it was unbelievable! As time would tell, everything she said came to pass.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "very kind female voice" the experiencer believed was "an angel," described as emanating "pure unconditional love."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Telepathic reading of the EMT's thoughts; reassurance from a female angelic presence.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The experiencer reported reading the EMT's thoughts in the ambulance and receiving specific predictive reassurance that many tests would find nothing.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I could read his thoughts.” “A very kind female voice spoke to me saying, ‘No. That would never be asked of your parents.’” “The calm and feeling of pure unconditional love that emanated from her was far past anything possible for human beings.” “They would run tests on me, a lot of tests, but never fear for they will find nothing.”
